summary.name: LiveFaceSwap AI
summary.one_liner: A cloud-based live webcam face swap tool that applies AI face, outfit, and style transformations in real time, with a desktop app that outputs to OBS and video-call apps as a virtual camera.
use_cases: Livestreaming with a swapped face in OBS
Using an AI-transformed camera feed in video calls
Quick webcam face swap tests in the browser
Comparing face references and AI models
Creative character or outfit styling on live camera
summary.what_it_does: Sends your webcam feed to the cloud, where an AI model swaps your face using a portrait reference you upload or choose from presets, and returns the output with stated latency under 500 ms. The browser preview lets you test effects, references and models without installing anything or owning a GPU. The page also mentions outfit changes and visual or character styles applied to the live camera. The Desktop app adds virtual-camera output for OBS, streaming software, and meeting or video-call apps. The page says the camera feed is not saved and cannot be viewed by other users.
notable: Cloud processing, so no local GPU or model downloads are needed
Desktop app provides virtual-camera output for OBS and video-call apps
Browser preview with up to 60 seconds free after sign-up
Reports under 500 ms latency for the AI output
caveats: Free trial is limited to up to 60 seconds; fuller use requires plans or credits (details not on the page)
Desktop app is listed only for Windows 11 and macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon
Camera feed is sent to the cloud for processing
